pro_course_detail.title: Casual Learner: American English Conversation
pro_course_detail.description:
This course is designed for people who are interested in exploring American English language and culture for personal enrichment and enjoyment. Whether you're a beginner or an experienced learner looking to brush up on your skills, these lessons are suitable for everyone!

In this course, we'll have exciting conversations about a wide range of topics, including film & TV, books, music, current events, trends, life, work, school, family, relationships, sports, opinions, beliefs, and much more! Our primary focus will be on improving your communication skills.

During our lessons, we will talk about how to effectively use:
-Colloquial expressions
-Idioms
-Phrasal verbs
-Slang
-North American pronunciation
-Grammar & Vocabulary

To keep your curiosity and motivation levels high, I provide a diverse range of materials. We'll utilize videos, podcasts, and audio activities that offer authentic language practice. You'll also engage in creative writing assignments to further enhance your skills and express your ideas effectively. Role-plays will allow you to simulate real-life conversations, and learning games will make the process enjoyable and interactive. Additionally, we'll analyze news articles to stay updated and integrate progress tests to track your development.

My aim is to create an immersive and dynamic learning environment where you can confidently engage in American English conversations. I'll be there every step of the way to support and guide you as you progress towards your language goals.

If you have any questions or would like to enroll in this course, please feel free to reach out. I'm excited to join you on this journey of exploring American English and helping you enhance your conversation skills!
